ledger: Female dancer | woman with hair in a bun wearing a black Y-back sports bra and black leggings, barefoot, with tattoos on her right rear shoulder and left tricep, standing facing the studio mirror with right arm extended | same woman facing the mirror in a pose with right arm curved overhead and weight on right leg | at 00:02 her foreground body abruptly flips poses to left-arm-up and weight-on-left-leg with her right-shoulder tattoo disappearing, contradicting her ongoing right-arm movement in the mirror reflection, before snapping back to right-arm-up at 00:03

Dancer's mirror reflection | reflection in the studio mirror matching the dancer's right-arm lift and stance | reflection matching the dancer's final overhead right-arm pose | remains in the right-arm-raised pose at 00:02 while the foreground dancer abruptly switches to having her left arm raised

findings.description: Between 00:01 and 00:03, while raising her right arm with her weight on her right leg, the foreground dancer abruptly snaps at 00:02 into an opposite pose with her left arm raised overhead, right arm down, weight shifted onto her left leg, and her right-shoulder tattoo missing, while her mirror reflection continues to show her right arm raised overhead; at 00:03 she instantaneously snaps back to having her right arm raised and right-shoulder tattoo visible.
